about: How often apps lay out each kind of paragraph, for the real-usage sample (harness/sets/sample.ts). A weighted list is [[value, share, source], ...]; shares are relative within their list. A source is a key of `sources` or starts with 'guess:', saying what the guess leans on. The sample draws `draws` paragraphs by these weights, then tops every group in sample.ts up to `minimumPerGroup` draws and weights each draw back to its real share. Only macOS rendering is measured: Android and Windows are 38.66% and 26.49% of page views (SC) and aren't covered.

sources.SC: StatCounter Global Stats, August 2026: gs.statcounter.com/platform-market-share/desktop-mobile-tablet and /screen-resolution-stats/mobile/worldwide and /desktop/worldwide (read 2026-09-23)
sources.HA25: HTTP Archive Web Almanac 2025, Fonts, almanac.httparchive.org/en/2025/fonts (read 2026-09-23)
sources.HA24: HTTP Archive Web Almanac 2024, Markup, almanac.httparchive.org/en/2024/markup (read 2026-09-23)

sources.E17: Microsoft Edge Platform Data, a crawl of 2017-11-22, read from Wayback copies of developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/platform/usage/css/
sources.DISCORD: 10,699 messages of the Discord Unveiled extract of public servers, read through the Hugging Face dataset viewer on 2026-09-23; only counts were kept, no text
sources.WILDCHAT: 2,980 user and 3,001 assistant turns of WildChat-1M, read through the Hugging Face dataset viewer on 2026-09-23; only counts were kept, no text
sources.APPS: text widths from the apps' own rules: Telegram Web (bubble 85% of the chat, screen width - 89 px on phones), Signal Desktop (min(306px, 100% - 38px)), the Vercel chatbot template (min(80%, 56ch) at 13px), Open WebUI (90%, pre-wrap), and Pretext's bubbles (80% of the chat), markdown-chat (0.78 of a chat capped at 860 px) and masonry (columns up to 400 px) demos
sources.ISSUES: filed issues: #74 and #142 (Korean reviews and chat under keep-all), #210, #212, #225 and #334 (table cells 25-135 px wide)

pools.notCheckedIn: No chat that users wrote. WildChat-1M (huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/WildChat-1M, ODC-BY) and OpenAssistant oasst2 (huggingface.co/datasets/OpenAssistant/oasst2, Apache-2.0), licenses read 2026-09-24, both allow redistribution with attribution, but downloading them waits for the maintainer's OK. The Discord Unveiled extract's license wasn't checked, so its text stays out. Until one is added, every chat draw is a stand-in.
